item.title: StupidMirror 0.3.8
item.description:
• Fix USB iPhone mirroring freezing or dropping after brief USB re-enumerations or Configuration 6/7 switches (CMIOGraphStart for setRunning (err=-67520)). Stopping or retargeting a USB session now tears down the old CMIOGraph, replaces the AVCaptureSession, and resolves the newly published AVCaptureDevice instance even when its uniqueID is unchanged.
  • Observe AVCaptureSession.runtimeErrorNotification and add a USB first-frame watchdog so a wedged capture graph automatically tears down and recovers.
  • Avoid starting one-shot USB ThumbnailCapture sessions while device control, an smtunnel sidecar, iPhone setup, or the --mcp-background daemon is active, preventing iOSScreenCaptureAssistant idle timers from resetting the USB bus and dropping active tunnels.
  • Retry iOS control tunnel startup across transient USB re-enumeration windows and automatically resume desired control sessions when a device reconnects.
